text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambia press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The roads traffic commision directs the United Transport and Taxis Association to cut domestic fares following a marginal cut in fuel prices.
- The Namibian High Commission says Namibia is sending a 37-man trade delegation to Zambia to strengthen trade ties between the two countries.
- Refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in northern Zambia complain of starvation.
- President Frederick Chiluba names two women as supreme court judges - the first women to sit on the supreme court bench.
- Home affairs minister Chitala Sampa says the Zambian government will soon start training the defence forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
- Police ban opposition rallies planned for the capital.
